name: AXM Module Footprint & Storage Pressure Observatory
actions: measure active files and bytes per top-level module
surface each module's largest observed file
group exact file bytes by lowercase extension
record excluded directories and skipped symlinks
scan explicitly named Workshop and Mirror roots without following symlinks
classify operational retention pressure with protected-by-default fallbacks
prove same-size exact duplicate groups with SHA-256
measure directory fan-out and cluster-rounded allocation pressure
compare separately timed storage snapshots without performing cleanup
summary: Read-only module footprint plus whole-root Workshop and Mirror storage-pressure evidence: exact logical bytes, SHA-256 duplicate groups, operational retention classes, directory fan-out, and snapshot deltas.
notes: Path classes are review routing, not semantic truth. Duplicate hashes prove equal bytes, not disposability. Allocated bytes are a cluster-rounded estimate. The module never deletes, links, compresses, packages, installs, promotes, or changes CANON.
